history.prompt:
An open blank matte notebook with empty pages and a slim pen lying across it on a dark slate surface, cool light from the upper left, one small brass paperclip. Everything sits in the lower half of the frame; the upper 45% is empty ground. Shot straight from above. No printed or written text anywhere.

Visual style: calm, precise, premium, quiet confidence. A matte deep slate-ink ground (#181C1C to #0C2027) with fine film grain, one soft cool light source. Palette: near-black, slate (#A9B2B4), mist white (#F4F9F9), a hint of muted teal and at most ONE small gold (#F5C13A) accent. Large areas of deliberate empty negative space so text can be placed on top later. Flat, restrained, editorial. Avoid: neon, lens flare, glossy 3D blobs, cyber grids, circuit boards, rockets, light bulbs, handshakes, stock-photo people, faces, hands, fake UI, charts, and any text, letters, numbers, logos or watermarks in the image.
